title: Compose State and Events knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the main idea of “Compose State and Events”?
options: It makes versioning, input validation, and testing unnecessary.
It means all Kotlin libraries and platform APIs behave identically.
It removes the need to understand types or runtime behavior.
Compose UI is a function of state; state ownership, events, and recomposition boundaries affect correctness and performance.
questions.answer_key: Compose UI is a function of state; state ownership, events, and recomposition boundaries affect correctness and performance.
questions.explanation: The reliable answer is grounded in the lesson’s main principle: Compose UI is a function of state; state ownership, events, and recomposition boundaries affect correctness and performance. Review the example and one relevant edge case before moving on.

Assume the compiler or toolchain is broken without reducing the example.
Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.

questions.answer_key: Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
